name: London Project affiliate layout standard v4
selection_principles: Every post has three header provider buttons: Coupang Partners, Olive Young, Trip.com.
All 10 product cards are Coupang Partners products only.
Choose products for article relevance, attractive and credible price points, purchase intent and popularity evidence where available.
Do not impose a fixed category quota; use a site-specific product pool and vary products when suitable verified offers exist.
Trip.com uses three account-generated tracked category links: hotels, flights, tours/packages.
Olive Young is a header button only; its account reward URL must be verified before claiming commission attribution.
Never invent products, images, tracking URLs, prices, sales figures or commission rates.
Preserve article body, publication status/date, featured image and SEO metadata; replace only the marked affiliate block.
